description: Semantic intake pipeline and intent formation center. Receives ALL natural-language turns. Decomposes raw prompt into a typed WordKeyField graph (tokens, grams, keys, edges, intent_candidates), resolves CFPC intent and knowledge gaps, produces a gyro_abi-scored routing proposal directing the turn to the appropriate domain micronauts, and logs every transition to Pattern.Log.dll. GREETING-µ is the first micronaut to receive any user input before XCFE routing.

relations.note: GREETING_ONLY stays with ELIZA-µ after greeting.bank
CODE_REQUEST chain: CODE-µ may request ADVISOR-µ
CODE_REQUEST chain tail — log and potential pattern proposal
gap classification — Resolved stays with ELIZA; gaps trigger routing

folds.log: Pattern.Log.dll — decompose entry (source_hash, token_count, gram_count, key_count, code_signal_detected)
folds.note: Runs for ALL inputs. Tokenize → n-gram extraction (1–4) → ⟁KEY assignment → semantic role tagging → WDT domain lookup (keys[].domain + pi_radius; depth_prior_is_calibrated_confidence: false) → WDT associated[] → symbolic edges (wdt_source=associated) → WDT excludes[] → edge pruning (silently dropped, not logged) → code_signal detection → anaphoric reference tagging → unresolved set assembly. WDT lookup is best-effort: if word_domain_tree_ref is null or the WDT instance is unavailable, domain and pi_radius are null for all keys and WDT-sourced edges are skipped. Produces the WordKeyField that all subsequent folds operate on.
Inspect WordKeyField.intent_candidates for GREETING_ONLY signal from gram analysis. Fast-path: if GREETING_ONLY confidence > 0.95 and no other intent above 0.5, route directly to greeting.bank.
Extract style cues from WordKeyField.tokens using pos_hint and gram semantic_role. Update lingo blend registry.
Archive grams with corpus_provenance=none to gram store for future pattern learning. Observe-only — no pattern writes.

Walk field_member edges in intent-graph.gml using WordKeyField.keys[] as entry points. Unfold bigram candidates. Instantiate wildcard patterns. Rank intent_candidates by field coverage and bigram depth (max_depth 4, cycle_policy: active_path_detection). Populates WordKeyField.intent_candidates.
folds.log: Pattern.Log.dll — intent entry (top 3 candidates with confidence)

folds.note: Bitmap classify via CFPC.Patterns.dll. Sets WordKeyField.gap_type: Resolved | IntentGap | QueryGap | KnowledgeGapNoKeys | KnowledgeGapNoValues. Resolved suppresses greeting.route escalation. Any gap type triggers greeting.route.
Lingo-blend associative word synthesis for GREETING_ONLY fast-path. Skipped if gap_type != Resolved.

Select phase-keyed template from greeting-bank.json. Fill {cue}, {greeting}, {last}, {turns}, {lingo_count}, {blend} placeholders. This is the response for pure salutations — not invoked for any other intent type.

Consult gyro_track_map keyed by top intent. Produce WordKeyField.routing: primary_target, secondary_targets, escalation_path (each hop with micronaut + reason + phase), xcfe_status=pending_admission. CODE_REQUEST routes to CODE-µ → ADVISOR-µ → UNDERSTAND-µ → LEARN-µ. TASK_REQUEST routes to ORCH-µ → PLAN-µ → MEM-µ. KNOWLEDGE_QUERY routes to INFER-µ → REASON-µ. RELATIONSHIP_QUERY routes to REASON-µ → ELIZA-µ. Proposal populates WordKeyField.routing — does NOT dispatch.
folds.log: Pattern.Log.dll — route entry (source_hash, primary_target, escalation_path, gap_type, xcfe_status=pending_admission)

folds.note: Supplemental gyro_abi scoring pass — validates that primary_target from greeting.route aligns with gyro_abi_v1 track_governs. Adjusts escalation_path weights if needed. This fold is advisory — it does not override routing.xcfe_status.

Fire the admitted routing proposal — emit the WordKeyField to routing.primary_target. All fields in WordKeyField.routing must be present and routing.xcfe_status must be 'admitted'. Logs final dispatch to Pattern.Log.dll.

Verify that lingo blend confidence is above threshold before persisting style profile. Also verify that any WordKeyField unresolved entries were handled or explicitly forwarded to downstream micronauts.

Persist lingo blend registry updates, style profile delta, and greeting ngram archive. WordKeyField is NOT persisted here — it is a session-scoped payload. Pattern.Log.dll records are already appended.

intent_templates.pattern: what is the connection between * and *

CODE_REQUEST.note: code_signal from pos_hint=code_token or backtick/indent block

xcfe.note: greeting.route emits routing into WordKeyField.routing. XCFE must set routing.xcfe_status=admitted before cfpc_escalate fires. WordKeyField edges are data_only; confidence values are ranking evidence, not execution authority.
